Case file two. England under-twenty-ones' youngest ever player.

beats.caption: Case file two. England U21s' youngest ever player.

beats.say: Not his first milestone. Against Leeds: the Premier League's second-youngest ever.
Then Prague: youngest player ever in the Champions League. Moukoko's record? Gone.

card.sub: 15 yrs, 308 days · beat Moukoko (16 yrs, 18 days)

beats.say: And it gets wilder. Against Everton: an assist, then a solo goal. Arsenal's Goal of the Season. He's also the Premier League's youngest ever scorer.

card.sub: Arsenal's 2025/26 Goal of the Season · also: youngest PL goalscorer ever

beats.say: At sixteen: youngest Premier League title winner. France next.

card.label: U16 · U17 · U19 · *U21*
card.sub: youngest PL title winner · next: France, Ashton Gate, 16 Nov

beats.say: Next record in his sights: Ansu Fati's, youngest Champions League scorer. He has until February twenty twenty-seven. Does he do it? Follow for the next Scout File.
